title: Anchors Aweigh with Disney
intro: [excited] All aboard, landlubbers! Tonight's episode sets sail with Disney Cruise Line: the ships, the private islands, the pirate parties and the statues in the lobby. [laughs] Life jackets optional, buzzers required!

art.prompt: A grand navy-and-red ocean liner with golden trim sailing across a turquoise sea at sunset, fireworks bursting above the deck, a sandy private island with palm trees and a lighthouse on the horizon Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

categories.title: Movie Ships Ahoy
categories.intro: Before the real ships, there were the movie ships. [chuckles] Name these famous Disney vessels.

art.prompt: A fleet of fantastical sailing vessels on a moonlit sea: a pirate galleon with tattered black sails, a glowing solar-sail space ship, a riveted steampunk submarine and a ghostly barnacle-covered ship rising from the waves Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Captain Hook sails the skies and seas of Never Land aboard this pirate ship.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is the Jolly Roger! Tick-tock, Captain. Mind the crocodile.

clues.clue: Captain Jack Sparrow's beloved ship, with its famous black sails, is called this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Black Pearl! [excited] Fastest ship in the Caribbean, as Jack will remind you. Savvy?

clues.clue: In Treasure Planet, Jim Hawkins ships out on this solar-sailing vessel commanded by Captain Amelia.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is the RLS Legacy! RLS for Robert Louis Stevenson, who wrote Treasure Island. Nice touch, Disney.

clues.clue: In Pirates of the Caribbean, Davy Jones commands this cursed ship that can sail beneath the waves.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Flying Dutchman! [whispers] Part of the ship, part of the crew. Brrr.

clues.clue: In Atlantis: The Lost Empire, Milo Thatch's expedition sets off in this giant submarine, named for a Greek hero.
clues.reveal: [impressed] The correct answer is the Ulysses! It doesn't last long against the Leviathan, but what a ride. True Disney nerd points!

categories.title: Ship Spotting
categories.intro: Real photos of Disney ships out at sea. Tell me what you're looking at! [chuckles] Binoculars are allowed.

art.prompt: A pair of brass binoculars, a captain's hat and a nautical chart on a sunny ship deck railing, a distant ocean liner on a turquoise horizon Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Launched in 2022, this ship, shown here at Castaway Cay, is named after a song lyric from Pinocchio. Name the ship.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Disney Wish! When you wish upon a star, apparently you get a cruise ship.

clues.clue: This ship, docked at Disney's newest Bahamas island destination, is named for something you do when you sleep.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Disney Dream! [chuckles] It launched in 2011 and brought the AquaDuck water coaster with it.

clues.clue: The Disney Wonder sits at Prince George Wharf in this capital city, a classic Bahamas port of call.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Nassau! [laughs] Capital of the Bahamas and a regular stop for Disney ships since the very beginning.

clues.clue: During a season Down Under, the Disney Wonder is about to pass under this famous steel arch.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is the Sydney Harbour Bridge! The Wonder brought Mickey's cruises to Australia and New Zealand. G'day, mate!

clues.clue: Disney Adventure, the line's biggest ship, is based year-round in this Asian city-state.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Singapore! Disney Adventure is homeported there, making it the line's first ship based in Asia. True sea-dog points!

categories.title: Pirates and Pixie Dust
categories.intro: Daily life on board a Disney ship: the parties, the kids clubs and the dinners. [laughs] Roll call is at dinner time.

art.prompt: A festive ship deck at night strung with lanterns, a pirate flag on the mast, fireworks over dark water, a dinner table with an artist's paintbrush and palette beside the plates Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: The horns of Disney's ships play the opening notes of this classic Pinocchio song.
clues.answer: When You Wish Upon a Star
accept: when you wish upon a star
choices: When You Wish Upon a Star
A Dream Is a Wish Your Heart Makes
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is When You Wish Upon a Star! [laughs] Easily the most charming horn on the ocean.

clues.clue: On Disney cruises, this themed night ends with a deck party and fireworks at sea. Bring your eye patch!
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Pirate Night! [whispers] Yo ho. Disney was the first cruise line to set off fireworks at sea.

clues.clue: Kids head to this onboard club, a play space with themed rooms and Disney counselors.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Oceaneer Club! [chuckles] Parents, enjoy your quiet dinner. The kids won't want to leave.

clues.clue: At this dining room, the walls start in black-and-white sketches and fill with color as the meal goes on.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Animator's Palate! It opened on the Disney Magic in 1998, and now it's on every ship. The room literally comes to life.

clues.clue: Fan cruisers hang this pocket-filled organizer outside their stateroom door to swap small gifts with fellow passengers.
clues.reveal: [impressed] The correct answer is a fish extender! Named for the little fish decorations outside each cabin, it's a fan tradition, not an official Disney program. True cruiser points!

categories.title: Castaway Cay Days
categories.intro: Disney's private islands in the Bahamas. [excited] Sand between your toes and trivia in your brain!

art.prompt: A sun-drenched private tropical island with a white-sand lagoon, a floating water-slide platform, hammocks between palm trees and a striped lighthouse on a rocky point Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Disney's private island Castaway Cay is in this island nation.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Bahamas! Castaway Cay has welcomed Disney ships since 1998.

clues.clue: In 2024, Disney opened its second Bahamas destination, Lookout Cay at Lighthouse Point, on this long, skinny island.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Eleuthera! [chuckles] Pink-sand beaches and a cultural focus on Bahamian art and history.

clues.clue: Grown-ups escape the kids at this adults-only beach on Castaway Cay.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Serenity Bay! [whispers] Shhh. It's for the adults. Ages 18 and up only.

clues.clue: Before Disney bought it, Castaway Cay was known by this Spanish-sounding name.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Gorda Cay! Disney rebranded it as Castaway Cay. Locals still remember the old name.

clues.clue: Swimmers at Castaway Cay can climb onto this floating platform in the family lagoon, with two water slides.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Pelican Plunge! It floats right out in the lagoon. Swim out, slide down, repeat until dinner.

categories.title: Who's in the Lobby?
categories.intro: Every Disney ship greets you with a statue or a character mascot. Name who's waiting for you. [chuckles] Wave hello!

art.prompt: A soaring ship atrium with a sweeping double staircase, a glittering chandelier, gold railings and an empty marble pedestal spotlit in the center, waiting for a statue Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: The Disney Wonder's atrium is home to a bronze statue of this mermaid princess.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Ariel! Fitting for a ship. [laughs] She finally got her legs AND a cruise.

clues.clue: On the Disney Dream, the atrium statue shows this famous duck dressed as an admiral.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Donald Duck! [chuckles] Admiral Donald. Don't ask him about the time he steered.

clues.clue: The Disney Fantasy's atrium statue is Mademoiselle this character, dressed like a fancy lady of the 1920s.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Minnie Mouse! [laughs] Mademoiselle Minnie, very art nouveau, very chic.

clues.clue: The Disney Treasure's Grand Hall features a statue of this couple from Agrabah on a magic carpet.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Aladdin and Jasmine! The Treasure's theme is exotic adventure, so a carpet ride fits perfectly.

clues.clue: On the stern of the Disney Magic, this goofy character dangles from a rope, painting the ship.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Goofy! Hanging off the back of the ship with a paint bucket. Gawrsh! True Disney nerd points!
